exclude: Most experiments unless they demonstrate an important theoretical principle
principles: Broaden beyond topics closely related to my own publications
Rank by conceptual interest and personal relevance
Explain unfamiliar concepts with brief background and motivation

selection.count_policy: Rank all qualifying papers from the complete batch; include all if twenty or fewer qualify, otherwise select the top twenty
selection.additional_papers: No minimum quota or preferred count; fewer than ten is acceptable; do not pad or add redundant contributions

format: Clean numerical ranking and daily overview; summary, background, and why it matters for each selected paper, up to twenty, without priority verdicts
